purpose: Define a replica as an explicit copy/synchronization participant identity bound to an exact source scope, destination scope and replication profile, separate from the source data identity.

topics.name: DWH Replica Identity
topics.purpose: Define a replica as an explicit copy/synchronization participant identity bound to an exact source scope, destination scope and replication profile, separate from the source data identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Each replica/sync participant has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.source_rule: Replica references exact authoritative/source instance/schema/data scope.
semantics.destination_rule: Replica references exact destination instance/storage scope.
semantics.copy_rule: Replicated records may have local storage identities but retain source semantic/lineage refs.
semantics.role_rule: authoritative, replica, cache and peer roles are explicit.
semantics.ownership_rule: Replica existence does not transfer semantic ownership from authoritative source.
semantics.state_rule: configured, syncing, current, stale, conflicted and failed states remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Replica availability does not grant source or destination mutation authority.

invariants.rule: Replica/sync state, transport position or local copy never replaces the semantic identity or ownership of the authoritative source data; propagation is explicit, provenance-bearing and conflict-aware.

hard_gates.condition: replica id replaces source data identity
source role inferred from newest timestamp

references.purpose: Replica destination uses explicit persistence binding.
Remote source may be reached through governed DWH addressing.
